## Solution

<!-- prep:solutions:start -->
<details>
<summary><b>Python</b> (spoiler) · <code>0258-add-digits.py</code></summary>

```python
class Solution:
    def addDigits(self, num: int) -> int:
        s = str(num)
        length = len(s)

        if length <= 1:
            return num
        
        while length > 1:
            sum = 0
            for i in range(len(s)):
                sum += int(s[i])
            s = str(sum)
            length = len(s)
        
        return int(s)
```

</details>
